description: Perimetri dei Consorzi Irrigui e di Miglioramento Fondiario is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by siatservices.provincia.tn.it. Perimeters of the Irrigation and Land Improvement Consortia that insist on the territory of the Autonomous Province of Trento. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Perimeters of Irrigation and Land Improvement Consortia" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include agricoltura, conmifoi, opendata, irrigazione, open data, consorz. The listing shows 2026-03-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
